fields.summary: Peralta Community College District runs the Gateway to College Alternative High School at Laney College. This amendment adds $301,571.51, raises the agreement's cap from $836,945.38 to $1,138,516.89 according to the attached amendment form, and extends the end date from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2028. The official text instead states a new cap of $1,038,407.72, which does not match the added amount.

25-2068.note: The new agreement total was corrected from the printed $1,038,407.72 to $1,138,516.89, the figure on the attached amendment form.
25-2068.sourceIssue: The official text's numbers don't add up: $836,945.38 plus $301,571.51 is $1,138,516.89, but it states a new total of $1,038,407.72. The attached amendment form lists $1,138,516.89.
